fact: The ministry's Plano Tecnológico da Educação of May 2019 sets out programme 5.1, to develop, test and implement a Sistema Electrónico de Gestão de Informação Académica (SEGI) with attendance control, with the indicator that in a first phase 100% of secondary schools and 10% of primary schools take part, and to extend it to schools where there is connectivity; it is a plan and states no school yet using it.
title: Plano Tecnológico da Educação: As TICs transformando a educação e a escola em Moçambique
publisher: Ministério da Educação e Desenvolvimento Humano
